harbour.label: Harbour
harbour.description: Deep maritime navy with a cool grey page. The most conservative of the set — the one to reach for when a site has to look institutional.

ember.label: Ember
ember.description: Warm charcoal lit by a single ember orange. Reads as evening rather than alarm, and keeps the orange for the one thing that matters on the page.

linen.label: Linen
linen.description: A soft warm neutral built for long-form reading: low contrast between paper and surface, generous type, nothing competing with the text.

orchid.label: Orchid
orchid.description: Muted purple with a cool paper. Distinctive without shouting, and the only theme in the set whose accent reads as decorative rather than corporate.

cobalt.label: Cobalt
cobalt.description: A saturated engineering blue on near-white. Built for dashboards and documentation, where a strong accent has to survive being repeated fifty times.

moss.label: Moss
moss.description: Deep forest green, quieter and colder than Astryx's own matcha. For organisations that want green without looking like a wellness brand.

clay.label: Clay
clay.description: Terracotta and warm stone. Earthy without being rustic, and the softest radius in the set so nothing has a hard corner.

plum.label: Plum
plum.description: Deep aubergine on a faintly warm page. Dark, adult and a little editorial — the theme for a publication rather than a product.

sand.label: Sand
sand.description: Desert warmth: pale ochre paper, dark umber ink. Bright without being white, which suits sites read outdoors or on cheap screens.

ink.label: Ink
ink.description: Near-black on white at the highest contrast the set offers. The one to pick when an accessibility statement has to survive scrutiny.

lagoon.label: Lagoon
lagoon.description: Blue-green water on pale sand. Fresher than Cobalt and warmer than Harbour, without tipping into turquoise.

rose.label: Rose
rose.description: Dusty rose, deliberately desaturated so it reads as considered rather than sweet. Pairs a serif heading with a plain body.

graphite.label: Graphite
graphite.description: Cool monochrome with no hue at all in the brand colours. The neutral of last resort, for sites whose imagery has to supply every bit of colour.
